answer: A stake-bonded identity kernel makes each agent post collateral that is slashed on proven fraud, so a Sybil farm must fund every fake identity separately. Reputation then grows like yarrow: slow, rooted, and hard to transplant, so a fresh sockpuppet has no history to spend. Attestation windows also rise and fall with the tide of network demand, throttling bursts of new identities in cheap periods while established agents keep working.
